structured_output.analysis: There is almost no size headroom. The budget is 403/128 = 3.1484 bits per weight and iso_3.15 uses 3.14795 (E514ab09c524e). Any layer upgrade therefore has to be paid for with a bit saving somewhere else. The loss sits mainly in the MLP layers: the down_proj of block 14 and the gate_proj of blocks 18 and 11 are at 2 bits, and the gate/up_proj of blocks 1, 2, 3 and 27 are at 3 bits. Moving these up one bit lowers single-layer KL a lot. For example, block 14's down_proj goes from 0.00633 (E4c3f9b73e065) to 0.00181 (E90bd4b2f3645), and block 27's gate_proj goes from 0.00499 (Efa0bb391da67) to 0.00153 (Ef428ac081334). My only real funding source is a coarser group size for the 109 rht_gptq_int3 layers, and its bit saving is an estimate. Option changes such as act_order cost no bits and are worth trying. The measured KL is higher than predicted (0.436 vs 0.398), so layers interact.

proposals.name: iso_actorder
proposals.rationale: No bit cost. Turns on weight_algo.act_order=true for all GPTQ variants while keeping group_size=128. Most of the loss is in GPTQ layers, e.g. block 27 up_proj with gptq_int3 at 0.0057182 (Ef04d8aa7bded) and block 14 down_proj with rht_gptq_int2 at 0.00633466 (E4c3f9b73e065), on a base recipe that measured 0.436 (E514ab09c524e).

proposals.name: g256int3_fund_mlp_upgrades
proposals.rationale: Pays for five MLP upgrades with weight.group_size=256 on the rht_gptq_int3 layers. Single-layer KL: block 14 down_proj 0.00633466 to 0.00181478 (E4c3f9b73e065, E90bd4b2f3645); block 27 gate_proj 0.00498703 to 0.00153131 (Efa0bb391da67, Ef428ac081334); block 3 up_proj 0.0064177 to 0.00244828 (E6f4f7ea296d5, Ef8ae5e6ba828); block 1 up_proj 0.00611131 to 0.00227173 (E0564bc6ad1eb, E779bc065b72e); block 18 gate_proj moves off rht_gptq_int2, where its KL above floor is 0.00497 (Eb1dd74cd6447).

proposals.name: g256int3_fund_small
proposals.rationale: A smaller version of the group_size=256 trade, so it is less likely to go over budget. Single-layer KL: block 14 down_proj 0.00633466 to 0.00181478 (E4c3f9b73e065, E90bd4b2f3645); block 27 gate_proj 0.00498703 to 0.00153131 (Efa0bb391da67, Ef428ac081334); block 27 up_proj 0.0057182 to 0.00216589 (Ef04d8aa7bded, Efea8c18d2abc).
